name: LY-367,265
summary: LY-367,265 is a drug of the tetrahydropyridinylindole group developed by Eli Lilly, which acts as both a potent and selective antagonist at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, and also a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI). It has antidepressant effects in animal studies, reduces glutamate signalling in the brain and increases the analgesic effects of morphine.

uses.text: LY-367,265 is a drug of the tetrahydropyridinylindole group developed by Eli Lilly, which acts as both a potent and selective antagonist at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, and also a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI).

fact.en: It packs two actions into one molecule, blocking serotonin reuptake like an SSRI while also blocking 5-HT2A receptors. Its tetrahydropyridinylindole group also includes Lundbeck's Lu 35-138.
fact.zh: 它把兩種作用集中在同一個分子上，既像 SSRI 一樣阻斷血清素回收，又阻斷 5-HT2A 受體。它所屬的四氫吡啶基吲哚類也包括靈北的 Lu 35-138。
